column1: # Declarative symlink manifest. Consumed by scripts/link.sh and scripts/unlink.sh.
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
# Order is preserved — put parent-directory symlinks (e.g. ~/.agents) before
# SSH — config + keys live under ~/.secrets/ssh/ (vault-backed, never in repo);
# config exposes prod infra so it stays out of git. Only allowed_signers
# (public key, non-secret) is repo-tracked. Symlink everything to ~/.ssh/<name>.
# Tool auth — canonical files under ~/.secrets/config/; consumer paths symlinked
# (vault rsync restores the tree; `make link` wires consumers after restore)
# Agents — whole-directory symlink (must precede ~/.claude/* entries below)
# Claude Code / Craft Agent — wire ~/.claude/ into the agents tree
